description:
Ladder Pick makes random 1:1 matching fun and fair — right inside ChatGPT.

Just tell ChatGPT who's playing and what's up for grabs. A virtual ladder game runs instantly, and you can reveal results all at once or one by one for extra suspense. Reshuffle anytime for a fresh draw.

Perfect for: team assignments, gift exchanges, chore rotations, and any situation where you need a fair random pick.

defaultPrompt: Play a ladder game with Ted, MJ, Tony. The items are Free, Lunch, Coffee.
